The '''Trasse system''' a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that was a home to a large [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] field. One of the largest of those asteroids, [[Trasse/Legends|Trasse]], was used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as a secret prison and [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] factory. To maintain its security, the Trasse system was highly monitored, to the point that no ship could pass through the system without alerting the Empire.
